protocol: Frozen prospective matched-label-placebo ablation, all cells reported. Reuse no confirmation or prior experiment teachers.
primary: At k=12, base learning rate .003, 131072 total training labels per augmented arm, compare true first-sign against a within-batch cyclic shift by one record. Use clean hard deployed parity error, true-minus-shift in percentage points, two-sided exact sign test over 12 paired teachers (ties omitted). Describe average paired difference with 95% teacher-level percentile bootstrap interval.
secondary: Rate .020 repeats the comparison. Report all per-teacher errors and matched-record final-only baseline at both rates. Final-only uses 65536 labels for 65536 records and cannot be counted as an equal-label comparator. True and shifted auxiliary arms receive exactly the same multiset of additional labels in every minibatch. These are mechanistic/descriptive comparisons. No inference on asymptotic query exponent.
pairing: Common normalized query, teacher, raw feature and noisy parity stream, shared small random initialization, fixed held-out 8192 records and signs across 6 arms per teacher. Each of 65536 distinct records is consumed once. Fixed cyclic shift by one across all 256 records of a minibatch is a derangement, with no independent pseudo-label distribution or batch-count difference. No early stopping or hyperparameter selection. First-sign labels are clean only in the informative arm.
resampling: 50000 bootstrap resamples of all 12 teachers, same draws for all cells, NumPy default_rng(726099), pointwise percentile intervals.
